title: Structural and biochemical insights on the mechanism of action of the clinical USP1 inhibitor, KSQ-4279
authors: Rennie M; Gundogdu M; Arkinson C; Liness S; Frame S; Walden H
one_liner_zh: 该文研究USP1抑制剂与蛋白的相互作用机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: DNA damage triggers cell signalling cascades that mediate repair. This signalling is frequently dysregulated in cancers. The proteins that mediate this signalling are potential targets for therapeutic intervention. Ubiquitin-specific protease 1 (USP1) is one such target, with small molecule inhibitors already in clinical trials. Here we use biochemical assays and cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) to study the clinical USP1 inhibitor, KSQ-4279 (RO7623066), and compare this to the well-established, tool compound, ML323. We find that KSQ-4279 binds to the same cryptic site of USP1 as ML323 but disrupts the protein structure in subtly different ways. Inhibitor binding drives a substantial increase in thermal stability of USP1, which may be mediated through the inhibitors filling a hydrophobic tunnel in USP1. Our results contribute to the understanding of the mechanism of action of USP1 inhibitors at the molecular level.
abstract_zh: DNA损伤触发介导修复的细胞信号级联反应。这种信号传导在癌症中经常失调。介导此信号传导的蛋白质是治疗干预的潜在靶点。泛素特异性蛋白酶1（USP1）就是这样一个靶点，其小分子抑制剂已进入临床试验阶段。在此，我们利用生物化学分析和冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-EM）研究临床USP1抑制剂KSQ-4279（RO7623066），并将其与成熟工具化合物ML323进行比较。我们发现KSQ-4279与ML323结合于USP1的同一隐蔽位点，但以微妙不同的方式破坏蛋白质结构。抑制剂结合显著提高USP1的热稳定性，这可能通过抑制剂填充USP1中的疏水隧道来介导。我们的结果有助于在分子水平上理解USP1抑制剂的作用机制。
